data.explanation: This is an ordinary invoice for office supplies (toner and paper), including 19% VAT (USt). The letter asks for payment of €156.91 by 13 May 2026, but it also prints a due date (Fälligkeitsdatum) of 20 May 2026. To be safe, pay by the earlier date, 13 May 2026, or ask the company which date applies. Use invoice number BB-4471 as the payment reference. If this was a business purchase, keep the invoice for your records, since it may matter for your tax return.
